mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever noticed how the patterns in our lives, the little things we do almost without thinking, can quietly set the tone for everything—our days, our goals, even the way we see ourselves? What if you could take just one intentional step and start a journey that leads to real, lasting change? Together, we're going to explore how self-awareness and setting healthy boundaries can make all the difference. And that's exactly what Jen Sincero unpacks in her inspiring book, Badass Habits: Cultivate the Awareness, Boundaries, and Daily Upgrades You Need to Make Them Stick. Jen invites us to look closer at the habits we carry, showing how even the tiniest shift—done with purpose—can open the door to remarkable growth. We’ll dive into why breaking old routines isn’t just about willpower. Instead, it’s about uncovering those hidden motivations and beliefs that really guide our choices. As we move through these ideas, you'll see how gaining clarity, making steady commitments, and practicing a little more kindness toward yourself are all part of the process. Jen’s approach centers on small, daily upgrades—simple actions anyone can take to reinforce new habits and gently reshape who we think we are. We'll discover how awareness and boundaries work together, giving us a map to move from self-sabotage to genuine self-mastery. With each new insight, the path ahead gets a little brighter—and the possibility for real change feels that much closer. So, if you’re ready to see what happens when you start showing up for yourself in new ways, let’s take this first step together.
